message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 6.6.0 Official Release Notes
This major release introduces full 3D alignment suites, cross-platform Figma SVG parsing, parametric shape morphing, an overhaul to the AutoCaptions engine, zero-lag timeline controls, and local asset generation arrays.

♦️ Align Tool
1. Multidimensional Coordination: Upgraded the transform alignment system to natively compute and parse anchor properties for 3D layers across spatial dimensions.
2. Flexible Anchor Targets: Implemented layout targets enabling spatial alignment relative to bounds selections, parent composition boundaries, or key structural objects derived from the final active index layer selection.

♦️ Figma & Shape Tabs
1. Direct Design Vector Mapping: Integrated a live clipboard monitoring system allowing editors to instantly execute 'Copy as SVG' inside Figma and parse raw vector data directly into fully structured native After Effects shape layers.
2. Path Transformation Framework: Implemented a dynamic shape morphing engine allowing seamless layout transitions between custom shape layer path variables while maintaining structural vertex counts.
3. UI Animation Stabilization: Resolved rendering errors across internal UI shape templates where vector parameters failed to evaluate, replacing dead placeholder square layers with full parametric UI sequences.

♦️ AutoCaptions Tab
1. Whisper Core Expansion: Expanded the localized captioning framework to natively parse all 99+ languages supported by OpenAI's Whisper model via a searchable dropdown component featuring live filtering.
2. Subtitle Fill Gaps Toggle: Added a 'Fill Gaps' logic switch to bridge caption spaces under 2.0 seconds, auto-saves localized .srt subtitle files right alongside the active project folder, and integrates a 15-session historical transcription cache dropdown.
3. Style Panel & Persistence Memory: Integrated an inline font property and layout scaling editor inside the panel interface. Added an environment cache script to preserve configurations across window re-opens.
4. Dedicated Panel Undo Button: Integrated a built-in undo utility shortcut to clear history stack buildup and resolve intermediate timeline lag generated during active property slider dragging adjustments.

♦️ Orb Generator Tab
1. Vector Path Orbiting: Re-engineered spatial distribution engines to map components smoothly alongside custom vector path coordinates.

♦️ Comp Saver Tab
1. Animated GIF Preview Integration: Appended local runtime modules to the Comp Saver UI grid to dynamically display fluid, loopable GIF asset previews directly inside the project memory layout.

♦️ Reference Tab
1. AI Background Remover: Embedded an offline background removal script directly within the Reference tab to isolate target foreground layer vectors instantly with a single button click.
2. Google Icons Resource Node: Appended an expansive asset browser inside the Reference tab routing directly to active Google icon libraries to scrape, download, and import design shapes seamlessly.
3. Social Media Bypass Cookie Matrix: Extended cookie loading parameters to read active structural cookie fields, resolving access restrictions to securely download high-definition Pinterest clips, Instagram Reels, and multi-platform media feeds.

♦️ Production Utilities
1. Trim to Below Layer Modifier: Added a layout shortcut execution button to immediately cut and snap target layer end boundaries to match the layer block sitting below them.
2. Windows Timeline Layout Fix: Re-calibrated style boundaries and DOM elements to repair fractured Timeline Manager configurations specific to Windows operating systems.
3. Organize Project Refactor: Optimised messy directory scanning matrices to process and clean project items significantly faster with minor asset tracking friction.

♦️ Text Tab
1. Trending Typography Presets: Added 'Breaking' text animations and optimized 'CC Light Sweep' expression glow trackers into the core text preset repository.
